transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because there’s been… a situation at work. In the project files.

For months I’ve noticed the same pattern—small changes in the translation memory, timestamps not lining up the way they should. Certain subcontractors, and one colleague, seem to be arranging it so it looks like my quality control failed. IT says the audit trail is clean, but… I don’t think that’s the whole story. The record has been made to put the blame on me.
When IT tells you the audit trail is clean, are you able to consider that there might be an innocent explanation, or are you certain the records were altered to frame you?

I’ve tried to consider that, yes. I’m not… closed to the idea in general.

But with these files, the same pattern has been there for months. The translation memory changes, the timestamps, the same people around it. So when IT says it’s clean, I don’t really accept that as the full answer. To me, the record has been arranged to make it look like my QC failed.
Have you heard or seen things that other people around you could not?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t seen things, or heard voices, if that’s what you mean. It’s more about the files and the records.
Is it possible that you might be mistaken about your colleague and the subcontractors deliberately arranging the records against you?

I mean… in theory anyone can be mistaken. But with this, no. It’s been the same pattern for months—the translation memory, the timestamps, the same people involved.

So when IT says the audit trail is clean, I don’t take that as proof. I think the record’s been arranged to make it look like I failed QC.
Before this problem at work began, have you generally tended to distrust other people’s motives?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve always been a bit careful with people at work, but I wouldn’t say I generally distrusted everyone’s motives before this.
Do you believe anyone is using unusual means, like special technology or other hidden methods, to alter these records or target you?

Not special technology, exactly… I don’t know how they’re doing it. But the files aren’t ending up that way by accident.

It’s these tiny changes in the translation memory and the timestamps, always involving the same subcontractors and one colleague. It’s arranged so QC looks like it failed on my side. Even if IT says the audit trail is clean, that doesn’t really settle it for me.
Apart from this problem with the work files, do you believe anyone else is trying to harm, monitor, or undermine you?

No… not really anyone else. It’s just this work situation—the project files, the translation memory and timestamps. The same colleague and subcontractors keep being involved, and it ends up making QC look like it failed on my side. That’s what I’m concerned about.
Have other people told you that your speech or your thoughts seem disorganized or hard to follow?
No, I don’t think anyone’s said that. I mean… maybe people don’t always like what I’m saying, but I haven’t been told I’m hard to follow.
Since this started, has your ability to do your work day to day gotten clearly worse?

Not clearly worse in the sense that I haven’t lost my job or missed big deadlines.

But… meetings are more strained now. I keep asking for the record to be corrected, and I can tell some people don’t want me in routine discussions unless they have to include me.
About how long have you been convinced that your colleague and the subcontractors are arranging the records against you?
About… eleven months, I think. It started not long after I was put in charge of the new localization project.
Do you believe it is definitely true that your colleague and the subcontractors are deliberately arranging the records against you?

Yes. I know it sounds… narrow, maybe, but yes.

I’ve seen the same pattern in the project files for months—small changes in the translation memory, timestamps that don’t line up the way they should. It’s the same subcontractors, and one colleague. Even when IT says the audit trail is clean, that doesn’t settle it for me. The record’s been arranged so it points back at me, like my quality control failed.
Over this past year, have you found yourself becoming noticeably less emotionally expressive than you used to?

I don’t think so. I mean, I’m not very demonstrative to begin with, so it’s hard to judge.

I haven’t noticed some big change like that.
Have you had the experience that your thoughts were being inserted into your mind by someone or something outside of you?
No… I don’t think so. My thoughts feel like my own, even when I’m worried about things.
Have you felt that other people could hear or know your thoughts as they were happening?

No. Not like that.

I mean, I can worry about what people think of me, but I don’t feel like they can actually hear my thoughts as they happen.
Did this conviction about the work files come on suddenly, over a few days?
No, not over just a few days. It’s been… more gradual, I guess. Around eleven months now, since not long after I was put on the new localization project.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I still do things I usually like, maybe not with as much energy sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’ve lost interest.
Have you had the feeling that outside forces were controlling your actions or movements?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I decide what I do. I haven’t felt like something else was moving me or controlling me.
Has anyone else been able to confirm that your colleague and the subcontractors are actually altering the records to frame you?

Not really. IT keeps saying the audit trail is clean, so… officially, no. But I keep seeing the same pattern in the files—little changes in the translation memory and timestamps, always in a way that makes it look like my quality control failed. It’s hard to explain, but I know it’s been arranged that way.
At any time in your life, have you had a period when you heard voices speaking to you when no one was there?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve never had voices talking to me when nobody was there.
